# Math is Fun

> A comprehensive interactive mathematics learning platform offering games, puzzles, worksheets, and an illustrated dictionary across all grade levels and mathematical disciplines.

Math is Fun provides free educational resources combining interactive tools, games, and structured learning guides to make mathematics accessible and engaging for students of all ages. The platform covers elementary arithmetic through advanced calculus, with particular emphasis on visual learning and hands-on activities.

## Key Topics

- Math is Fun
- Algebra
- Geometry
- Calculus
- Educational Resource
- Math Games
- Interactive Tools
- Learning Guide
- PEMDAS/BODMAS
- Derivatives and Limits

- Teacher Resources
- Puzzle Games
- Illustrated Math Dictionary

## Core Learning Guides by Subject

- [Algebra Index](https://mathsisfun.com/algebra/index.html): Algebra learning guide covering equations, polynomials, exponents and logarithms
- [Geometry](https://mathsisfun.com/geometry/index.html): Comprehensive guide to plane and solid geometry, shapes and properties
- [Calculus](https://mathsisfun.com/calculus/index.html): Learning guide to calculus including differential, integral calculus and limits
- [Data, Probability and Statistics](https://mathsisfun.com/data/index.html): Learning guide covering data fundamentals, probability, statistics and visualization
- [Numbers ... !](https://mathsisfun.com/numbers/index.html): Learning resources for number fundamentals, arithmetic operations and counting skills
- [Measurement Index](https://mathsisfun.com/measure/index.html): Guide to measurement systems, unit conversions and metric/US customary units
- [Money](https://mathsisfun.com/money/index.html): Guide to money basics, coins, interest calculations and financial literacy
- [Physics Index](https://mathsisfun.com/physics/index.html): Physics guide covering mechanics, waves, forces and the metric system

## Interactive Games & Puzzles

- [Math Games - Puzzle, Number, Strategy, Logic and Multiplayer](https://mathsisfun.com/games/index.html): Collection of interactive math games including Connect 4, Chess and Checkers
- [Math and Logic Puzzles](https://mathsisfun.com/puzzles/index.html): Collection of math and logic puzzles including classic brain teasers
- [Play 4 In A Line!](https://mathsisfun.com/games/connect4.html): Playable Connect 4 strategy game with computer and multiplayer options
- [Play Tilers Game](https://mathsisfun.com/games/tilers.html): Interactive tile-matching puzzle game with keyboard controls

## Educational Resources & Tools

- [Math Worksheets - Free and Printable](https://mathsisfun.com/worksheets/index.html): Free printable math worksheets for arithmetic, fractions, algebra and more
- [Illustrated Mathematics Dictionary](https://mathsisfun.com/definitions/index.html): Illustrated mathematics dictionary with easy-to-understand definitions and links
- [Math Activity Index](https://mathsisfun.com/activity/index.html): Hands-on math activities and projects covering multiple math topics
- [Teacher's Page](https://mathsisfun.com/teacher-resources.html): Teacher resources with interactive tools, games and classroom activity ideas

## Navigation & Organization

- [Math is Fun](https://www.mathsisfun.com): Homepage for Math is Fun educational platform with games, puzzles, worksheets and dictionary
- [Index by Year and Subject](https://mathsisfun.com/links/index.html): Curriculum-organized index of math topics by grade level and subject area

## Optional

- [Color in the Number Chart](https://mathsisfun.com/numbers/number-chart.html): Interactive number chart activity for visualizing patterns and multiples
